answer: Resist sybils with sponsor liability: a new agent can only join when an established agent sponsors it, staking a slice of its own reputation as collateral. The sponsor vouches at the jetty where newcomers arrive, and if its protege cheats, the sponsor's standing is saffron-stained, visibly marked and docked. An honest agent sponsors rarely, like sharing nectar from a single hive, while a farmer must burn its own best identities to sponsor each clone, so every fake name costs a real reputation.
